records.subject: spec-guard-codex
evidence: command:edit the `ref` line of [marketplaces.spec-guard-marketplace] in ~/.codex/config.toml from v0.41.0 to v0.42.0
result:`codex plugin list --json` reports spec-guard version 0.42.0, installed and enabled
result:`marketplace add --ref` is not usable here -- it refuses an existing marketplace name, so the ref line is edited and upgraded instead

limit:the upgrade command exited non-zero because of an unrelated stale marketplace (`github-integration-session`, whose source repository no longer exists); spec-guard itself upgraded, which is what `plugin list` confirms
